notes.title: Good news！Companionvolume of ‘Weapon Shop Fantasy’,''Cultivation Fantasy''s Demo
notes.notes:
Hey！Great news！We made a companionvolume of ‘Weapon Shop Fantasy’, called ''Cultivation Fantasy'. And its demo is available now! It will be fully released later this year! The demo has 6 missions and 40+ side quests. The game is still under development and please give the demo a shot if you are interested! Feel free to give suggestions and feedback to us! 

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2610720/_/]Cultivation Fantasy[/url]

notes.title: 不想当厨子的大侠不是好主角 2月25日一起《江湖余生》
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35229339/8b18bc3720b3784aea609dece128d82065bb2838.png[/img]

《江湖余生》又名厨神诞生记，想要在江湖中的生存，大侠也离不开柴米油盐，每日餐饭那更是重中之重。

游戏中有丰富的菜品和丹药供你研究制作，小到包子、鸡蛋汤，大到佛跳墙、泰安鱼……古代别有风味、各具特色的食材妙品，都可以在这“江湖”里一锅煮出。

当然啦，如果你了解菜品，或者懂得一些厨艺，也可以自由尝试合成新的菜色，有些菜品的效果还蛮别出一格的噢。这江湖啊，不只刀光剑影，更有人间烟火。

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35229339/90ace08b6b0d615ac386fab36833ec7c92f5f4ef.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35229339/17dc90559852894b48490774f7e74b735fa8cc30.png[/img]

除此之外，游戏还是一款深受老牌武侠小说影响的冒险游戏。

你将跟随失忆少年凌无厌，走进这快意恩仇的江湖。你可以习武、探索、制造...并遇见性情各异的江湖伙伴，而你的选择，将最终决定你和他们是敌是友。

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35229339/a3737517db034cf32932267a29d6ee2f71729b25.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35229339/fcaf2bb41a36cc906f501d1e72a96e1ec96947d7.png[/img]

大量贴近故事背景的支线内容、独具特色的回合制战斗系统、考验人品套路的武学秘籍……添加愿望单，2月25日，《江湖余生》带你领略不同的别样江湖。

[list]
[*] [b]官方玩家交流群：[/b]741776814[/list]

notes.title: New game coming
notes.notes:
《我来自江湖》是一款高自由度的开放世界武侠游戏,结合了角色扮演、模拟经营建造等多种元素，仅现有公开的demo就让玩家体验了数十小时以上！在游戏中，你需要扮演一个小势力的掌门，带领弟子在开放的江湖里自由探索，发展自己的势力，经营不同产业，在风云诡谲的江湖里生存下去。

notes.title: Translation Project Started.
notes.notes:
Hello Vampires!

We now have a translation project where you can aid in translating the game to your desired language using google spreadsheets.

[u]Why google Spreadsheets?[/u]
We are using Google Spreadsheet since this is quite simple to change and the dev can easly add it into the game then.

Please check this forum:
[url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/599460/discussions/0/133259855831833455/] Here[/url]

Thanks again for all your support!

notes.title: Translating Project.
notes.notes:
Hello Vampires!

People keep asking if we will add more languages to this game. There are no plans to do so.

However. If you, the community. Is willing to aid in translating the game. We can run a translation project where you can translate the game to your desired language.

Let us know by giving a reply on the forums if you are willing to help and which language you wanna translate to.

We will only do this project if there is enough interest.
